paletteOrigin: assets/source/old-site/cover2.png (Season One sleeve, watercolour by Julia Feisleben)

motion.wordmarkSoakIn: opacity 0 to 1, background-size 150% 260% to 100% 100%, saturate 0.3 to 1, 1900ms ease-out-expo, runs once, never loops
motion.hypeSticker: transform 240ms ease-out-expo, rotate -8deg to -4deg on hover
motion.reducedMotion: the wordmark renders finished with no animation; smooth scrolling off
motion.webgl: none; the site ships no canvas and no animation library
motion.backgroundWaves: three keyframe sets (96s, 138s, 112s) on ease-in-out alternate, about 6% travel with 1-2deg of rotation, transform only, staggered per mark, none under reduced motion
motion.printHover: translateY(-3px) with a deeper sleeve shadow, 320ms ease-out-expo
motion.lyricsPanel: sheet-in 260ms ease-out-expo on open; native dialog handles focus, Escape and return
motion.wolvesGhost: ghost-gather 128s ease-in-out infinite, opacity 0 to the mark's resting strength and back while it drifts; three on the site (hero, music, collective), none under reduced motion
motion.reveal: reveal-in on a CSS view timeline, range entry 2% to entry 55%, translateY 14px with scale 0.988, transform only so text never renders at a blended colour; absent without view timelines and under reduced motion
motion.lightbox: sheet-in 240ms ease-out-expo on open; native dialog handles focus, Escape and return

wordmark.contrastGuard: the generator fails if any part of the wash drops under 3:1 against #f3f2f0

stains.technique: the paint's own density becomes an alpha channel, edges and corners faded so no crop leaves a rectangle; the file carries shape only
stains.usage: mask-image over a token colour, 0.10-0.34 opacity, two or three per section plus at most one wolves ghost, decorative, inside the section, hidden under forced colours and where masks are unsupported; never scale the mask past 100%, which would cut the faded edge into a rectangle

releaseTheming.guard: the generator refuses an accent under 4.5:1 on paper or a wash under 12:1 with ink; tests/unit/release-palette.test.ts asserts it

gallery.layout: CSS column flow: one column, two from 40rem, three from 64rem, break-inside avoid, no cropping
gallery.lightbox: native <dialog>, photograph at max-height 100dvh - 8rem, ink-deep backdrop at 78% with a 4px blur, paper close sticker
gallery.captions: only third-party credits under the thumbnails; the artist's own photographs are credited in the footer
